meta.name: fundraising-and-investor-relations
meta.description: Raises capital and manages the relationship afterward — deciding how much and why, understanding what dilution and preferences actually cost, running a process with real competitive tension, preparing for diligence before it starts, and reporting to investors and a board in a way that keeps support when results are bad. Use this to plan a raise, evaluate a term sheet beyond the valuation, prepare a data room, or fix reporting that is producing surprises.

copy.tagline: 规划融资全流程并管理投资者关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在为创业公司融资并需要处理投资方沟通
copy.tagline_en: Plan capital raising and manage investor relations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are raising funds for a startup and need to handle investor communication

howto.what: 该技能用于融资与投资人关系:按业务里程碑倒推融资金额,拆解清算优先权、反稀释等条款的真实成本,建议并行推进融资流程以制造竞争,并提醒提前备齐尽调材料、先报坏消息。
howto.when: 当你说到融资前的规划与条款谈判、准备尽调材料、或投后对投资人/董事会的汇报时触发。

say.text: 按 18 个月跑道倒推我们该融多少钱,但要保留一次失误的余量。
say.note: Claude 会基于里程碑反推所需金额,并纳入容错。

say.text: 这份条款清单的参与清算和反稀释条款,在几个退出情景下会怎样?
say.note: Claude 会建模不同退出结果下的回报影响。

say.text: 帮我把数据室的尽调材料列个清单,标出可能缺的 IP 转让文件。
say.note: Claude 会生成清单并标出潜在缺口。

howto.what_en: Guides fundraising and investor relations: calculate the raise from milestones, explain real costs of key term-sheet clauses, advise running parallel negotiations to create tension, and prompt early diligence prep plus reporting bad news first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you talk about planning a raise and term-sheet negotiations, preparing a data room for diligence, or communicating with investors/board after funding.

say_en.text: Back-calculate raise amount from an 18-month runway, with one error margin.
say_en.note: Claude derives the amount from milestones and adds buffer.

say_en.text: What are the real costs of the liquidation preference and anti-dilution here?
say_en.note: Claude models the impact across exit outcomes.

say_en.text: List the key data-room items for diligence and flag missing IP assignments.
say_en.note: Claude checks against a checklist and flags gaps.
